newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - RF Monolithics EPS upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - RF Monolithics EPS upped.

text.p: --Robertson, Stephens and Co analyst Dan Niles said he raised his earnings estimates on RF Monolithics Inc and reiterated a buy rating.
--Niles raised his fiscal 1997 earnings estimate to $0.55 per share from $0.50, and his fiscal 1998 estimate to $0.70 per share from $0.65.

--"For the past four quarters RF Monolithics has doubled its year-over-year EPS comparison," Niles said in a statement. "We believe the infrastructure that has been developed over the past several quarters is finally reaping rewards for the company."

--Niles also noted that the company's second quarter earnings of $0.12 per share doubled from the year-ago quarter and came in $0.02 above his forecast. "This is especially impressive considering Q2 has historically been RF Monolithics' weakest quarter with revenue and EPS typicaly sequentially flat to down," he said in a statement.
